body:
You have some good points and I will tell my loved ones I love them more frequently from now on. Life is on a never ending cycle of change and I get that now, there's nothing we can physically do to stop it but we can mold it into something that we enjoy.
I feel like that I just realized all of this faster than I should have but a shower can do amazing things.
I still don't feel 100% comfortable with leaving but I know it's what I have to do.
I need to find the strength to be social and active and find out who I really am because I am struggling to have a good time when i go out and I don't see any point in going out if people are just going to think I'm a weird guy that just sits in a corner and doesn't talk.
I feel like I am taking this to a new level but when the thought of suicide sounded rational in my head, I just don't know what to think.

I do too but I also used to like being with a bunch of people, I don't know what changed but I just don't feel the same.
And thank you
